reason: Article 13 of the AI Act focuses on the obligations of the provider regarding the technical documentation of a high-risk AI system, including its design, development, and training. It does not mandate the maintenance of an inventory of models, components, data sources, or subcontractors.

Article 25(4) of the AI Act pertains to the obligations of the provider to ensure that the high-risk AI system is accompanied by instructions for use and to provide information to users. It does not address the maintenance of an inventory of components or subcontractors.
